decision: SWE-bench stage 2 not executed; campaign ends at stage 1 (50 instances per model)
decidedBy: project owner (explicit instruction), resource-based as permitted by ADR 0011 decision 5

evidence.imagesMainPull: budget guard stopped pulls at +102.2 GB after 73 images (images-main/pull.log)

stage2Probe.note: 8 stage-2 images (astropy/matplotlib/scikit-learn/sympy/... repositories) increased Docker's deduplicated image storage by 41.5 GB although `docker image inspect .Size` reports 16.6 GB for them (inspect reports a smaller size than unpacked storage); removing exactly these 8 returned docker system df to 195.7 GB, confirming the attribution. At that rate the remaining 16 stage-2 images plus the 26 amendment-1 rerun images could not fit in the 100 GB budget.

evidence.stage1ImagesRemoved: 49 stage-1 images pulled by this campaign were removed after stage-1 evaluation (images-main/rmi-stage1.log), before amendment 1; 26 of them are re-pulled for the reruns (images-rerun1)
